description: Get TempGuru's published booking and procurement policies. Use for real booking questions that otherwise require an email: minimums, cancellation and rescheduling, no-show replacement, COIs, deposits and invoice terms, rush fees, and background checks. Terms set per order (such as a deposit percentage) are marked confirm_with_coordinator; never infer a missing number. <examples>get_policies() ; get_policies(topic='payment-terms') ; get_policies(topic='coi-additional-insured')</examples> <hints>Choose an advertised topic to return one policy. Narrow lexical aliases remain accepted, and unknown topics return the current available-topic list. This is an operational summary, not a contract.</hints>

topic.description: Optional canonical policy topic. Choose an advertised enum value; omit for all policies or a broader question.

name: get_policies

policy_found.description: Discriminator. false means the requested topic is not published.
